weapon_fire.notes: Gunshot, gunfire. Explicit firearm discharge in the final label and planned description; candidate mapping pending source-audio validation.

machine_gun.notes: Machine gun. The exact alias also covers the lowercase final label through the existing case normalization; no broader gunfire family is added.

explosion.notes: Explosion. Targets the named blast only; does not require subsequent fire or smoke sounds.

thud.notes: Thump, thud. Both final labels explicitly name the acoustic impact; no generic impact classes are added.

wizard_laughter.notes: Laughter. Candidate for the described wizard vocalization; the rendered voice and model response still require audio review. Animal or hybrid laughter labels are not included.

basketball_bounce.notes: Basketball bounce. The ontology specifies bouncing on a hard surface; backboard and hoop contacts are separate unsupported descriptions.

lubricant_spray.notes: Spray. The planned description specifies aerosol lubricant bursts, consistent with liquid droplets. Dirt and gravel spray is not included.

aircraft_engine.notes: Aircraft engine. Targets the explicitly identified aircraft engine; no jet, propeller, or generic roar class is assumed.

puppy_growl.notes: Growling. The ontology describes low guttural animal vocalization; leaf rustling and other puppy sounds are not included.

food_chopping.notes: Chopping (food). Explicit food cutting with a cleaver; generic Chop is not added. The existing merged-support reference ambiguity remains unchanged.

crowd.notes: Crowd. The planned description specifies audience and stadium background; no cheering, applause, or speech subclasses are presumed.

mechanical_fan.notes: Mechanical fan. Targets operation of the fan, not placement on a tub. Existing role-change reference ambiguity remains unchanged.

descriptions: Dirt bike engine revving through a forest trail
motorcycle_revving.notes: Accelerating, revving, vroom. Targets explicitly named engine revving only. The fictional underwater rendering has not been audio-validated; no motorcycle identity claim is made.

puff.notes: Puff. A short forceful air burst is explicit in the planned description; this is not an inferred panting or barking label.

trailer_rattle.notes: Rattle. Targets the named mechanical rattling; does not require other vehicle or tire sounds.

swing_whoosh.notes: Whoosh, swoosh, swish. Targets explicitly described airy swing motion; synthetic rendering still requires audio validation, and blade clashes are not included.

footsteps.notes: Walk, footsteps. Retains the two exact frozen aliases already present in the example mapping; combined shoe squeaks and footfalls are not included.

vehicle_engine.notes: Engine. Both descriptions explicitly identify an engine. This broad source class does not verify a particular engine type or hum timbre, and no descendants are added.
